video.title: My weekly planning setup with Notion AI
video.hook: The creator, sitting at a desk, says "here's how I plan my week with AI" while a Notion page fades in.
video.description: A calm walkthrough of a weekly planning template in Notion: a task database, a calendar view, and Notion AI summarising the week, explained with a voiceover and simple captions. Clear and pleasant, but similar to many other productivity videos. Ends with "template link in bio".
